title: SB3212 (2026 Regular): RELATING TO DETACHABLE AMMUNITION MAGAZINES.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2026/bills/SB3212_.HTM; sha256 3856b7d52d68cc0e14484213df79f6dd17b8871b0fb6af0aca95579db95601a3)
provenance.note: As-filed version. The bill restates all of HRS 134-8 as printed; only subsection (d) is described by the Description as new. Subsection (e) (relettered from (d), carries a codifier bracket) penalizes violations of (c) or (d) as a misdemeanor, or a class C felony if the magazine is inserted in a firearm; not quoted.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (HRS 134-8): (d) The use of a detachable ammunition magazine possessing a capacity in excess of fifty rounds with any firearm, except a pistol, shall be prohibited; provided that the use of a detachable ammunition magazine with a pistol shall be in accordance with subsection (c); provided further that this subsection shall not apply to ammunition magazines originally designed to accept more than fifty rounds of ammunition that: (1) Have been modified to have a capacity of less than fifty rounds; and (2) Are not capable of being readily restored to a capacity in excess of fifty rounds.
